```sql
WITH 
-- Step 1: Get administrative boundaries for Amsterdam and Rotterdam
city_boundaries AS (
    SELECT 
        NAMES:"local"::VARCHAR AS city_name,
        GEO_CORDINATES AS boundary
    FROM NETHERLANDS_OPEN_MAP_DATA.NETHERLANDS.V_ADMINISTRATIVE
    WHERE ADMIN_LEVEL = '8'
      AND LOWER(NAMES:"local"::VARCHAR) IN ('amsterdam', 'rotterdam')
),

-- Step 2: Filter roads by the specified QUADKEY segments
filtered_roads AS (
    SELECT 
        CLASS,
        SUBCLASS,
        TRY_CAST(LENGTH_M AS FLOAT) AS road_length,
        GEO_CORDINATES
    FROM NETHERLANDS_OPEN_MAP_DATA.NETHERLANDS.V_ROAD
    WHERE QUADKEY LIKE '12020210%' 
       OR QUADKEY LIKE '12020211%'
),

-- Step 3: Spatially join roads to city boundaries
road_city_assignment AS (
    SELECT 
        r.CLASS,
        r.SUBCLASS,
        r.road_length,
        cb.city_name
    FROM filtered_roads r
    INNER JOIN city_boundaries cb
        ON ST_INTERSECTS(r.GEO_CORDINATES, cb.boundary)
)

-- Step 4: Aggregate total road lengths by class, subclass, and city
SELECT 
    CLASS,
    SUBCLASS,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN city_name = 'Amsterdam' THEN road_length ELSE 0 END), 4) AS "Amsterdam_road_length_m",
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN city_name = 'Rotterdam' THEN road_length ELSE 0 END), 4) AS "Rotterdam_road_length_m"
FROM road_city_assignment
GROUP BY CLASS, SUBCLASS
ORDER BY CLASS, SUBCLASS;
```

WITH city_geometries AS (
    -- Extract Amsterdam and Rotterdam boundary polygons
    SELECT 
        "NAMES":"local"::STRING AS "city_name",
        "GEO_CORDINATES" AS "boundary_geom"
    FROM NETHERLANDS_OPEN_MAP_DATA.NETHERLANDS.V_ADMINISTRATIVE
    WHERE "ADMIN_LEVEL" = '8'
      AND (LOWER("NAMES":"local") LIKE '%amsterdam%' OR LOWER("NAMES":"local") LIKE '%rotterdam%')
),

road_lengths_by_city AS (
    -- For each road in the specified QUADKEY range, determine which city it belongs to
    SELECT 
        r."CLASS",
        r."SUBCLASS",
        cg."city_name",
        r."LENGTH_M"::FLOAT AS "road_length"
    FROM NETHERLANDS_OPEN_MAP_DATA.NETHERLANDS.V_ROAD r
    CROSS JOIN city_geometries cg
    WHERE (r."QUADKEY" LIKE '12020210%' OR r."QUADKEY" LIKE '12020211%')
      AND ST_INTERSECTS(r."GEO_CORDINATES", cg."boundary_geom")
)

-- Aggregate and pivot the data
SELECT 
    rl."CLASS",
    rl."SUBCLASS",
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN rl."city_name" = 'Amsterdam' THEN rl."road_length" ELSE 0 END), 4) AS "Amsterdam",
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN rl."city_name" = 'Rotterdam' THEN rl."road_length" ELSE 0 END), 4) AS "Rotterdam"
FROM road_lengths_by_city rl
GROUP BY rl."CLASS", rl."SUBCLASS"
ORDER BY rl."CLASS", rl."SUBCLASS";
```

WITH 
-- Generate hourly slots for October 1, 2022 (local time assumed CDT)
hourly_slots AS (
    SELECT 
        DATEADD(HOUR, SEQ8(), '2022-10-01 00:00:00'::TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AS "datetime"
    FROM TABLE(GENERATOR(ROWCOUNT => 24))
),

-- Price node metadata
price_node_info AS (
    SELECT 
        "OBJECTID" AS "price_node_id",
        "PNODENAME" AS "price_node_name"
    FROM "YES_ENERGY__SAMPLE_DATA"."YES_ENERGY_SAMPLE"."PRICE_NODES_SAMPLE"
    WHERE "OBJECTID" = 10000697078
),

-- Load zone metadata
load_zone_info AS (
    SELECT 
        "OBJECTID" AS "load_zone_id",
        "OBJECTNAME" AS "load_zone_name"
    FROM "YES_ENERGY__SAMPLE_DATA"."YES_ENERGY_SAMPLE"."DS_OBJECT_LIST_SAMPLE"
    WHERE "OBJECTID" = 10000712973
),

-- Hourly DART prices (DALMP and RTLMP)
price_data AS (
    SELECT 
        "DATETIME" AS "datetime",
        "TIMEZONE" AS "timezone",
        "DALMP" AS "dalmp",
        "RTLMP" AS "rtlmp"
    FROM "YES_ENERGY__SAMPLE_DATA"."YES_ENERGY_SAMPLE"."DART_PRICES_SAMPLE"
    WHERE "OBJECTID" = 10000697078
        AND "DATETIME" >= '2022-10-01 00:00:00'
        AND "DATETIME" < '2022-10-02 00:00:00'
),

-- Load forecasts (datatypeid 19060)
load_forecast_data AS (
    SELECT 
        "DATETIME" AS "datetime",
        "TIMEZONE" AS "timezone",
        "VALUE" AS "load_forecast",
        "PUBLISHDATE" AS "load_forecast_publish_date"
    FROM "YES_ENERGY__SAMPLE_DATA"."YES_ENERGY_SAMPLE"."TS_FORECAST_SAMPLE"
    WHERE "OBJECTID" = 10000712973
        AND "DATATYPEID" = 19060
        AND "DATETIME" >= '2022-10-01 00:00:00'
        AND "DATETIME" < '2022-10-02 00:00:00'
),

-- Wind generation forecasts (datatypeid 9285)
wind_forecast_data AS (
    SELECT 
        "DATETIME" AS "datetime",
        "TIMEZONE" AS "timezone",
        "VALUE" AS "wind_gen_forecast",
        "PUBLISHDATE" AS "wind_gen_forecast_publish_date"
    FROM "YES_ENERGY__SAMPLE_DATA"."YES_ENERGY_SAMPLE"."TS_FORECAST_SAMPLE"
    WHERE "OBJECTID" = 10000712973
        AND "DATATYPEID" = 9285
        AND "DATETIME" >= '2022-10-01 00:00:00'
        AND "DATETIME" < '2022-10-02 00:00:00'
),

-- Solar generation forecasts (datatypeid 662)
solar_forecast_data AS (
    SELECT 
        "DATETIME" AS "datetime",
        "TIMEZONE" AS "timezone",
        "VALUE" AS "solar_gen_forecast",
        "PUBLISHDATE" AS "solar_gen_forecast_publish_date"
    FROM "YES_ENERGY__SAMPLE_DATA"."YES_ENERGY_SAMPLE"."TS_FORECAST_SAMPLE"
    WHERE "OBJECTID" = 10000712973
        AND "DATATYPEID" = 662
        AND "DATETIME" >= '2022-10-01 00:00:00'
        AND "DATETIME" < '2022-10-02 00:00:00'
),

-- Actual wind generation (datatypeid 16)
wind_actual_data AS (
    SELECT 
        "DATETIME" AS "datetime",
        "TIMEZONE" AS "timezone",
        "VALUE" AS "wind_gen"
    FROM "YES_ENERGY__SAMPLE_DATA"."YES_ENERGY_SAMPLE"."TS_GEN_SAMPLE"
    WHERE "OBJECTID" = 10000712973
        AND "DATATYPEID" = 16
        AND "DATETIME" >= '2022-10-01 00:00:00'
        AND "DATETIME" < '2022-10-02 00:00:00'
),

-- Actual solar generation (datatypeid 650)
solar_actual_data AS (
    SELECT 
        "DATETIME" AS "datetime",
        "TIMEZONE" AS "timezone",
        "VALUE" AS "solar_gen"
    FROM "YES_ENERGY__SAMPLE_DATA"."YES_ENERGY_SAMPLE"."TS_GEN_SAMPLE"
    WHERE "OBJECTID" = 10000712973
        AND "DATATYPEID" = 650
        AND "DATETIME" >= '2022-10-01 00:00:00'
        AND "DATETIME" < '2022-10-02 00:00:00'
),

-- Actual load (final settlement)
load_actual_data AS (
    SELECT 
        "DATETIME" AS "datetime",
        "TIMEZONE" AS "timezone",
        "RTLOAD" AS "rtload"
    FROM "YES_ENERGY__SAMPLE_DATA"."YES_ENERGY_SAMPLE"."DART_LOADS_SAMPLE"
    WHERE "OBJECTID" = 10000712973
        AND "DATETIME" >= '2022-10-01 00:00:00'
        AND "DATETIME" < '2022-10-02 00:00:00'
        AND "RTFINAL" = 'Y'
),

-- Peak classifications from market times
peak_classification AS (
    SELECT 
        "DATETIME" AS "datetime",
        "TIMEZONE" AS "timezone",
        "ONPEAK" AS "onpeak",
        "OFFPEAK" AS "offpeak",
        "WEPEAK" AS "wepeak",
        "WDPEAK" AS "wdpeak",
        "MARKETDAY" AS "marketday",
        "DATETIME_UTC" AS "datetime_utc"
    FROM "YES_ENERGY__SAMPLE_DATA"."YES_ENERGY_SAMPLE"."ISO_MARKET_TIMES_SAMPLE"
    WHERE "ISO" = 'ERCOT'
        AND "DATETIME" >= '2022-10-01 00:00:00'
        AND "DATETIME" < '2022-10-02 00:00:00'
),

-- Combine all data with the hourly calendar
combined_data AS (
    SELECT
        'ERCOT' AS "iso",
        h."datetime",
        COALESCE(p."timezone", lf."timezone", wf."timezone", sf."timezone",
                 wa."timezone", sa."timezone", la."timezone", pc."timezone", 'CDT') AS "timezone",
        pc."datetime_utc",
        COALESCE(pc."onpeak", 0) AS "onpeak",
        COALESCE(pc."offpeak", 0) AS "offpeak",
        COALESCE(pc."wepeak", 0) AS "wepeak",
        COALESCE(pc."wdpeak", 0) AS "wdpeak",
        pc."marketday",
        pni."price_node_name",
        pni."price_node_id",
        p."dalmp",
        p."rtlmp",
        lzi."load_zone_name",
        lzi."load_zone_id",
        lf."load_forecast",
        lf."load_forecast_publish_date",
        la."rtload",
        wf."wind_gen_forecast",
        wf."wind_gen_forecast_publish_date",
        wa."wind_gen",
        sf."solar_gen_forecast",
        sf."solar_gen_forecast_publish_date",
        sa."solar_gen"
    FROM hourly_slots h
    LEFT JOIN price_data p ON h."datetime" = p."datetime"
    LEFT JOIN load_forecast_data lf ON h."datetime" = lf."datetime"
    LEFT JOIN wind_forecast_data wf ON h."datetime" = wf."datetime"
    LEFT JOIN solar_forecast_data sf ON h."datetime" = sf."datetime"
    LEFT JOIN wind_actual_data wa ON h."datetime" = wa."datetime"
    LEFT JOIN solar_actual_data sa ON h."datetime" = sa."datetime"
    LEFT JOIN load_actual_data la ON h."datetime" = la."datetime"
    LEFT JOIN peak_classification pc ON h."datetime" = pc."datetime"
    CROSS JOIN price_node_info pni
    CROSS JOIN load_zone_info lzi
)

-- Final report with net load calculations
SELECT 
    "iso",
    "datetime",
    "timezone",
    "datetime_utc",
    "onpeak",
    "offpeak",
    "wepeak",
    "wdpeak",
    "marketday",
    "price_node_name",
    "price_node_id",
    ROUND("dalmp", 4) AS "dalmp",
    ROUND("rtlmp", 4) AS "rtlmp",
    "load_zone_name",
    "load_zone_id",
    ROUND("load_forecast", 4) AS "load_forecast",
    "load_forecast_publish_date",
    ROUND("rtload", 4) AS "rtload",
    ROUND("wind_gen_forecast", 4) AS "wind_gen_forecast",
    "wind_gen_forecast_publish_date",
    ROUND("wind_gen", 4) AS "wind_gen",
    ROUND("solar_gen_forecast", 4) AS "solar_gen_forecast",
    "solar_gen_forecast_publish_date",
    ROUND("solar_gen", 4) AS "solar_gen",
    -- Net load forecasts and real-time
    ROUND(COALESCE("load_forecast", 0) - COALESCE("wind_gen_forecast", 0) - COALESCE("solar_gen_forecast", 0), 4) AS "net_load_forecast",
    ROUND(COALESCE("rtload", 0) - COALESCE("wind_gen", 0) - COALESCE("solar_gen", 0), 4) AS "net_load_real_time"
FROM combined_data
ORDER BY "datetime" ASC;
```

<details>
<summary><b>View SlayQL SQL (❌)</b></summary>

```sql
-- CTE to gather all hourly data components for October 1, 2022
WITH hourly_data AS (
    SELECT 
        pn."datetime" AS "datetime",
        'America/Chicago' AS "timezone",
        CONVERT_TIMEZONE('America/Chicago', 'UTC', pn."datetime") AS "datetime_utc",
        -- Peak classification logic
        CASE 
            WHEN DAYOFWEEK(pn."datetime") IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5) -- Weekdays (Monday=1 through Friday=5)
                 AND HOUR(pn."datetime") BETWEEN 7 AND 21 -- Peak hours 7:00 to 22:00 according to ERCOT
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END AS "onpeak",
        CASE 
            WHEN DAYOFWEEK(pn."datetime") NOT IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5)
                 OR HOUR(pn."datetime") NOT BETWEEN 7 AND 21
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END AS "offpeak",
        CASE 
            WHEN DAYOFWEEK(pn."datetime") IN (1, 7) -- Saturday and Sunday
                 AND HOUR(pn."datetime") BETWEEN 7 AND 21
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END AS "wepeak",
        CASE 
            WHEN DAYOFWEEK(pn."datetime") IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5)
                 AND HOUR(pn."datetime") BETWEEN 7 AND 21
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END AS "wdpeak",
        TO_DATE(pn."datetime") AS "marketday",
        pn."price_node_name",
        pn."price_node_id",
        pn."dalmp",
        pn."rtlmp",
        lz."load_zone_name",
        lz."load_zone_id",
        lz."load_forecast",
        lz."load_forecast_publish_date",
        lz."rtload",
        gen."wind_gen_forecast",
        gen."wind_gen_forecast_publish_date",
        gen."wind_gen",
        gen."solar_gen_forecast",
        gen."solar_gen_forecast_publish_date",
        gen."solar_gen",
        -- Net load calculations
        (lz."load_forecast" - COALESCE(gen."wind_gen_forecast", 0) - COALESCE(gen."solar_gen_forecast", 0)) AS "net_load_forecast",
        (lz."rtload" - COALESCE(gen."wind_gen", 0) - COALESCE(gen."solar_gen", 0)) AS "net_load_real_time"
    FROM 
        YES_ENERGY__SAMPLE_DATA.YES_ENERGY_SAMPLE.V_DATA_CATALOG_SAMPLE pn
    -- Join with price node data
    JOIN 
        YES_ENERGY__SAMPLE_DATA.YES_ENERGY_SAMPLE.DATATYPE_SAMPLE dt_pn
        ON dt_pn."INTEGRATION_RULE" = 'DOWN'
    -- Join with load zone data (node ID 10000697078)
    JOIN 
        YES_ENERGY__SAMPLE_DATA.YES_ENERGY_SAMPLE.V_DATA_CATALOG_SAMPLE lz
        ON lz."INTEGRATION_RULE" = 'DOWN'
    -- Join with generation data (object ID 10000712973)
    JOIN 
        YES_ENERGY__SAMPLE_DATA.YES_ENERGY_SAMPLE.V_DATA_CATALOG_SAMPLE gen
        ON gen."INTEGRATION_RULE" = 'DOWN'
    WHERE 
        pn."price_node_id" = 10000697078
        AND TO_DATE(pn."datetime") = '2022-10-01'
)

-- Final report combining all components
SELECT 
    'ERCOT' AS "iso",
    hd."datetime",
    hd."timezone",
    hd."datetime_utc",
    hd."onpeak",
    hd."offpeak",
    hd."wepeak",
    hd."wdpeak",
    hd."marketday",
    hd."price_node_name",
    hd."price_node_id",
    ROUND(hd."dalmp", 4) AS "dalmp",
    ROUND(hd."rtlmp", 4) AS "rtlmp",
    hd."load_zone_name",
    hd."load_zone_id",
    ROUND(hd."load_forecast", 4) AS "load_forecast",
    hd."load_forecast_publish_date",
    ROUND(hd."rtload", 4) AS "rtload",
    ROUND(hd."wind_gen_forecast", 4) AS "wind_gen_forecast",
    hd."wind_gen_forecast_publish_date",
    ROUND(hd."wind_gen", 4) AS "wind_gen",
    ROUND(hd."solar_gen_forecast", 4) AS "solar_gen_forecast",
    hd."solar_gen_forecast_publish_date",
    ROUND(hd."solar_gen", 4) AS "solar_gen",
    ROUND(hd."net_load_forecast", 4) AS "net_load_forecast",
    ROUND(hd."net_load_real_time", 4) AS "net_load_real_time"
FROM 
    hourly_data hd
ORDER BY 
    hd."datetime" ASC;
```
</details>

WITH block_group_population AS (

        f."BlockGroupID",
        f."CensusValue" AS "CensusValue",
        g."StateCountyTractID"
    FROM
        "CENSUS_GALAXY__ZIP_CODE_TO_BLOCK_GROUP_SAMPLE"."PUBLIC"."Fact_CensusValues_ACS2021" f
    INNER JOIN

    "TotalTractPopulation",
    ROUND("CensusValue" / NULLIF("TotalTractPopulation", 0), 4) AS "PopulationRatio"
FROM
    tract_totals
ORDER BY
    "StateCountyTractID",

WITH block_group_population AS (
    -- Get total population (MetricID = 'B01003_001E') for each block group in New York State
    SELECT
        "Fact"."BlockGroupID",
        "Fact"."CensusValue" AS "block_group_population",
        "Geo"."StateCountyTractID"
    FROM "CENSUS_GALAXY__ZIP_CODE_TO_BLOCK_GROUP_SAMPLE"."PUBLIC"."Fact_CensusValues_ACS2021" AS "Fact"
    INNER JOIN "CENSUS_GALAXY__ZIP_CODE_TO_BLOCK_GROUP_SAMPLE"."PUBLIC"."Dim_CensusGeography" AS "Geo"
        ON "Fact"."BlockGroupID" = "Geo"."BlockGroupID"
    WHERE "Fact"."MetricID" = 'B01003_001E'
      AND "Geo"."StateFIPS" = '36'
)
SELECT
    "BlockGroupID",
    "block_group_population" AS "CensusValue",
    "StateCountyTractID",
    SUM("block_group_population") OVER (PARTITION BY "StateCountyTractID") AS "total_tract_population",
    ROUND(
        "block_group_population" / NULLIF(SUM("block_group_population") OVER (PARTITION BY "StateCountyTractID"), 0),
        4
    ) AS "population_ratio"
FROM block_group_population
ORDER BY "StateCountyTractID", "BlockGroupID";

WITH top_ny_zip AS (
    SELECT 
        f."ZipCode",
        f."CensusValueByZip" AS "total_commuters_over_one_hour"
    FROM "CENSUS_GALAXY__AIML_MODEL_DATA_ENRICHMENT_SAMPLE"."PUBLIC"."Fact_CensusValues_ACS2021_ByZip" f
    INNER JOIN "CENSUS_GALAXY__AIML_MODEL_DATA_ENRICHMENT_SAMPLE"."PUBLIC"."LU_GeographyExpanded" g
        ON f."ZipCode" = g."ZipCode"
    WHERE g."PreferredStateAbbrev" = 'NY'
      AND f."MetricID" = 'B08303_013E'
    ORDER BY f."CensusValueByZip" DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    t."ZipCode",
    t."total_commuters_over_one_hour",
    b."StateBenchmarkValue" AS "state_benchmark_commuters_over_one_hour",
    b."TotalStatePopulation" AS "state_population"
FROM top_ny_zip t
CROSS JOIN "CENSUS_GALAXY__AIML_MODEL_DATA_ENRICHMENT_SAMPLE"."PUBLIC"."Fact_StateBenchmark_ACS2021" b
WHERE b."StateAbbrev" = 'NY'
  AND b."MetricID" = 'B08303_013E';

<details>
<summary><b>View SlayQL SQL (❌)</b></summary>

```sql
-- CTE to get the top NY zip code for commuters traveling over one hour (MetricID = 'B08303_011E')
WITH top_zip AS (
    SELECT 
        f."ZipCode", 
        f."CensusValueByZip" AS total_commuters
    FROM 
        CENSUS_GALAXY__AIML_MODEL_DATA_ENRICHMENT_SAMPLE.PUBLIC.Fact_CensusValues_ACS2021_ByZip f
    JOIN 
        CENSUS_GALAXY__AIML_MODEL_DATA_ENRICHMENT_SAMPLE.PUBLIC.LU_GeographyExpanded g
        ON f."ZipCode" = g."ZipCode"
    WHERE 
        g."PreferredStateAbbrev" = 'NY'
        AND f."MetricID" = 'B08303_011E'
    ORDER BY 
        f."CensusValueByZip" DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
-- CTE to extract state‑level values for the same metric and total population
state_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        MAX(CASE WHEN "MetricID" = 'B08303_011E' THEN "StateBenchmarkValue" END) AS state_commuters_over_1hr,
        MAX(CASE WHEN "MetricID" = 'B01003_001E' THEN "TotalStatePopulation" END) AS state_population
    FROM 
        CENSUS_GALAXY__AIML_MODEL_DATA_ENRICHMENT_SAMPLE.PUBLIC.Fact_StateBenchmark_ACS2021
    WHERE 
        "StateAbbrev" = 'NY'
        AND "MetricID" IN ('B08303_011E', 'B01003_001E')
)
-- Final output including zip code, total commuters, state benchmark, and state population
SELECT 
    t."ZipCode",
    t.total_commuters,
    s.state_commuters_over_1hr,
    s.state_population
FROM 
    top_zip t, 
    state_metrics s;
```
